                                                                      Capacity-Building for Palestinian Economic and Regulatory Institutions (P118560)

                         Operation Name: Capacity-Building for Palestinian Economic and Regulatory           Project Stage:   Implementation         Seq.No: 2      Status: ARCHIVED    Last Modified Date: 01-Feb-2011
                                          Institutions (P118560)
                                                                               Country: West Bank and Gaza                            Approval FY:        2010
                         Product Line: Special Financing                       Region: MIDDLE EAST AND NORTH AFRICA                   Lending Instrument: Technical Assistance Loan
                         Implementing Agency(ies): Ministry of Finance

                         Key Dates
                         Board Approval Date    24-Jun-2010              Original Closing Date 30-Jun-2014          Planned Mid Term Review Date 16-Jul-2012                Last Archived ISR Date 25-Sep-2010
                         Effectiveness Date     08-Sep-2010              Revised Closing Date 30-Jun-2014           Actual Mid Term Review Date

                         Project Development Objectives
                         Project Development Objective (from Project Appraisal Document)

                         To build the capacity of leading economic and regulatory institutions, in order to support the implementation of the Palestinian Reform and Development Plan.

                         Has the Project Development Objective been changed since Board Approval of the Project?

                            Yes           No

                         Component(s)
                         Component Name                                                                                                           Component Cost

                         Component 2: PMA (US$1m)                                                                                                            1.00
                         Component 3: PPA                                                                                                                    0.62
                         Component 4: Project Management                                                                                                     0.40

                         Implementation Status Overview
                         This project was approved by the Board on June 24, 2010 and made effective on September 8, 2010. This ISR was produced from the first Supervision Mission, held Jan 17-21,
                         2011. Project implementation is proceeding well overall, with particular progress made on the Palestinian
